item.title: SCP-5159:
item.content:encoded:
I'll throw a few comments in before this goes away…

— A couple very basic pet peeves:

No SCP should be allowed to wander around the containment site.

When something "appears" to do or be something, the implication is it is/does something completely different and the actual thing should be interesting enough to elaborate on somewhere in the article.

— The "Dr. Wondertainment" aspect doesn't really suit this object and feels tacked on.

— This guy is pretty much a living Mood Ring, which is somewhat amusing but you need to take that somewhere interesting. Since it's a pretty straightforward anomalous effect, maybe the way to go is to give him a good backstory. I was hoping to see that in the interview, but it didn't really add anything. There wasn't a hook on this one to make it at all memorable.

item.title: SCP-3476:
item.content:encoded: No harm done, honestly, it was a little extra thrill to read my name in this. I just use this name in various online communities and personal projects, so I wanted to avoid the possibility of a "wait, so, who's named after whom?" situation arising, no matter how unlikely. Funny that you chose Alex as the new name—McQueen in my username is in part a reference to the late great fashion designer, Alexander McQueen.

item.title: SCP-071: Test-log addendum 071-2?
item.content:encoded:
On ██/██/██ Dr. █████████ selected four D-class personnel who have all self-identified as asexual since early adulthood. One of these subjects (a female survivor of [DATA EXPUNGED]) was asked to describe SCP-071's current form, and complied: "It's some kind of clearish, colorless oval blob….no obvious features or body parts…it smells like unwashed sheets, and it keeps shrinking in on itself, making this squelching noise….turn me on? Oh jeez, no…quite the opposite, Doctor, this thing scares the [REDACTED] out of me. Could I please get one of those pills ans go back to quarters?"

The remaining D-class asexuals described a similar amorphous, translucent, and foul-smelling entity; as with D- █████████, all reported that SCP-071 shrabk away from them, as if in pain.

item.title: SCP-071: SCP-071 vs. sex-repulsed asexuals
item.content:encoded: Weird idea: what if sex-repulsed aces forced SCP-071 into its actual base form and made it extremely uncomfortable? If 071 "feeds" on lust, it would logically be "poisoned" by anti-sexual thoughts and feelings; if the nearest viewer had no ideal mate or fetish to copy, 071 would be too confused to keep any shape but its natural one.
